title: 第3章 特性 终焉蜕变第4章 生活的参差
content_zh:
【姓名：王生】
【年龄：15】
【异能：全身增幅】
【特性：na】
【异能强度：f】
【异能潜力：f】
王生一脸茫然地看着大屏幕上显示的内容。
“哪里好像不对劲啊......”
刚刚在觉醒仪内，伴随着异能觉醒之后，他面前还多出了一份穿越者常见的面板，只是内容嘛......
和觉醒仪上显示的不太一样。
【姓名：王生】
【年龄：15】
【异能：全身增幅】
【特性：终焉蜕变】
【终焉蜕变：死亡后，你将会复生并增强异能】
【异能强度：f-】
【异能潜力：∞】
“这何止是不对劲那么简单，我是不是外挂到账了？”
他呆愣在原地，有点不敢相信自己所看到的内容，他这是要逆天了啊。
系统啊系统......

我无限自杀你不炸了么？
此时此刻，除了王生本人之外，大家都将他流露出的这份茫然呆滞，理解成了一种希望破碎的绝望状态。
无特性异能。
这可是从来没出现过的事情，最菜的人都得有一种特性吧？
而且f级的潜力就意味着，他在异能一途上毫无前途，没有增长上限。
铁废物级别，和杨信坐一桌。
不过班主任老秦却是走上前来，拍了拍王生的肩膀：
“别灰心，哪怕是最低等的全身增幅，理论上也有助于你武道上的进展，世界还没完蛋操，你也一样。”
说罢，他朝王生勾了勾手掌：
“来，试试你觉醒后的实力，让我看看增幅如何。”
“嗯，好。”
王生如梦初醒，他并没有流露出什么悲伤，让文静和老秦都不由暗叹这孩子的沉稳。
很快，对练开始。
王生摆好架势，并未急着抢攻，他双脚一前一后分开，膝胯微沉，架子扎实，显然是日常桩功没少练。
紧接着，他聚精会神，感受起异能对自身的强化增幅。
content_en:
[Name: Wang Sheng]
【Age: 15】
[Superpower: Whole body amplification]
[Characteristic: na]
[Power strength: f]
[Superpower potential: f]
Wang Sheng looked at the content displayed on the big screen with a blank expression.
"Something seems wrong..."
Just now in the Awakening Instrument, with the awakening of the superpower, there was a common panel for time travelers in front of him, but it was just the content...
It is different from what is shown on the awakening meter.
[Name: Wang Sheng]
【Age: 15】
[Superpower: Whole body amplification]
[Characteristic: Final Transformation]
[Final Transformation: After death, you will be resurrected and have enhanced abilities]
[Power strength: f-]
[Power potential: ∞]
"This is more than just something wrong. Did I get a cheat to my account?"
He froze on the spot, a little unable to believe what he saw. He was about to go against the grain.
System, system...
If I commit suicide indefinitely, won’t you explode?
At this moment, everyone except Wang Sheng himself understood the daze he showed as a state of despair with broken hope.
No special abilities.
This is something that has never happened before. The best people must have a certain characteristic, right?
Moreover, the F-level potential means that he has no future in the development of supernatural powers and has no upper limit for growth.
Iron waste level, sitting at the same table as Yang Xin.
However, the head teacher, Lao Qin, stepped forward and patted Wang Sheng on the shoulder:
"Don't be discouraged. Even the lowest level of whole-body augmentation can theoretically help your progress in martial arts. The world isn't over yet, and neither are you."
After saying that, he raised his hand towards Wang Sheng:
"Come, try your strength after awakening and let me see how it increases."
"Yeah, okay."
When Wang Sheng woke up from a dream, he did not show any sadness, which made Wen Jing and Lao Qin secretly sigh at the child's calmness.
Soon, the sparring began.
Wang Sheng took up his posture and was not in a hurry to attack. He spread his feet forward and backward, his knees and hips were slightly sunk, and his stance was solid. It was obvious that he had practiced daily Zhuang Kung Fu.
Immediately afterwards, he concentrated his concentration and felt the amplification of his powers.
